approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.
approval.scope: One immutable V1R2 with canonical global-row batch128 deployment inference and a 0.25 mm qualification reproduction bound; zero training and zero C09/C10/M-TARE.

methods.baselines: Sealed scalar-projected trace-commit predecessor, immediate learned-ghost commit and fixed structured-rule trace commit.
methods.fallback: None. Failure stops the current event-center graph route; no threshold, radius or planner tuning is allowed.
methods.main: Use the arithmetic three-seed five-frame 3D structure center, then apply the frozen factorized association at the unchanged 4 m cap and require two independent traversals before node commit; edges require a completed physical trace. The canonical ensemble remains the arithmetic mean of the three archived seed centers, exactly matching qualification.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.center_reproduction: All 8,839 C07-C08 event rows must reproduce each qualified seed and ensemble within 0.00025 m maximum absolute local/world coordinate error; identities remain exact.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.fixed_proposal_threshold: Proposal threshold remains the predecessor value 0.97; no fit or validation reselection.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.improvement: node-edge macro-F1 improves the stronger immediate-ghost or structured-rule baseline by >=0.05
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.node: precision >=0.98, false loop merge <=0.01 and recall >=0.25
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.numeric_reproduction: Canonical all-row batching is fixed before graph replay; V1R observed seed/ensemble maxima 0.000179/0.000061 m, below the 0.00025 m bound.

purpose: Run the unchanged graph audit with canonical all-188126-row batch128 inference after V1R showed that different GPU batch packing is deterministic but not bit-exact.
retention: Retain three all-row seed projections, ensemble projection, qualification reproduction proof, graph nodes/edges/decision trace, pair scores, metrics, logs and seal. Delete each 2.526 GB deterministic spatial cache after use.

sampling.independent_unit: procedural world; physical support unit is a directed traversal
sampling.temporal_context: current plus four strictly past observations in the same traversal

split_logic: The predecessor proposal threshold 0.97 is fixed before this run. C01-C06 and C07-C08 are replayed only for capacity and disjoint validation evidence; no threshold, 4 m cap, association vote, commit rule, model or Teacher changes are allowed.
student_inputs: three frozen causal action-set model contexts
three frozen five-frame spatial-longitudinal event-center predictions
runtime route tangent and sensor pose
three frozen learned association models and learned exit tokens
executed traversal identity and causal within-world order
title: Qualified spatial-center trace-commit graph requalification V1R2

worlds.development_validation: 20 disjoint procedural worlds: topology families S01-S10, replicates C07-C08
worlds.fit_and_method_selection: 60 procedural worlds: topology families S01-S10, replicates C01-C06
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10, strict test and all M-TARE benchmark worlds
